headline: Market closed for weekend; IndusInd Bank terminates former CEO Sumant Kathpalia's services

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: The Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, due to the weekend.
Trading on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) will resume on Monday, 23 November 2026.
Investors are analyzing corporate updates and policy news ahead of the upcoming trading session.
Key developments include major executive changes at IndusInd Bank and RBI guidance on small-business lending.
whatHappening: IndusInd Bank terminated the services of Sumant Kathpalia and invoked clawback provisions.
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged commercial banks to step up lending to small businesses for greater economic gains.
CBIC issued draft GST proposals to shield genuine buyers from Input Tax Credit (ITC) losses.
Gokul milk union announced price hikes on buffalo and cow milk, leading to discontent among farmers.
summary:
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
Major corporate news includes IndusInd Bank terminating Sumant Kathpalia's services and invoking clawback clauses.
Macro news highlights the RBI Governor urging banks to boost small-business credit and draft GST changes by CBIC.
